//: Everything Ask AI can point at in Simple mode, the Advanced layout and the left sidebar. Ask AI's 'Show me' steps name an id; the app moves to its tab (or opens the report, folder or dialog it needs), finds the element and spotlights it. 'selector' defaults to [data-spot="<id>"]. 'item' says what the step's item names: 'match' means the element itself carries data-spot-item (a card or row); 'report', 'folder' and 'kit-review' mean the app opens that report, folder or the asset dialog for that report first. 'open' expands a collapsed section. 'page' (with 'workbook' for Sheets) is the Advanced page a 'classic' spot is on, opened first. 'layout' marks a spot that exists in one layout only ('simple', or 'classic' for Advanced); spots without it are in Simple's tabs and Settings, or in the sidebar of both layouts. Spots inside the Advanced 'Data tools' group open it first.

spots.what: The workspace switcher: the workspace the whole studio is using, with your role under its name (admins switch workspaces and start a new one here; in a one-workspace build it only shows the name)
Your role, and View as for admins: open the account menu to preview what an editor, a custom role or a channel owner sees

Home: the weekly briefing: what to do next, trends that need your OK, what changed, Recent (the Inbox's newest rows; the number on Home counts the unread ones), what's ready for channels, what shipped and what's running
Research programs: every program with its schedule, sources and budgets, Run now and Edit
Every research program at a glance: schedule, next and last run, sources and budgets, with Run now and Edit
Edit: opens the program's own page, with a Runs tab and its settings as tabs (Name & focus, Sources, Schedule, Budget, AI models, Automation, Advanced) and one Save program bar (item: program name)

Trends: say Yes or Skip to new trends, then Write reports; a trend's name or card opens the trend's own page (Overview, Trends report, Editorial toolkit, Channel assets, and its one next step); List or Board, and a program filter

Assets: every trend's reports, channel assets and pictures, quick scans, drafts and other files, by trend, by research run or as one All files table, with search and filters for date, program, channel and type
